elements.element: Commerce One must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1 million per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 14.11 requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: Section 14.11 requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: Section 14.11 requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Commerce One processes Customer Data, Commerce One must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5 million.
elements.evidence: Section 14.11 requires cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data. This language covers the required Customer Data processing condition.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Commerce One must provide certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Section 14.11 expressly requires Commerce One to provide certificates of insurance on request.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1 million.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the fallback USD 1,000,000 minimum.

elements.element: If Commerce One processes Customer Data, Commerce One must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires USD 5,000,000 in cyber liability coverage where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, exceeding the fallback USD 2,000,000 minimum.

result.reason: The clause meets all stated limits, the conditional cyber requirement, and the certificate requirement, but omits workers' compensation insurance, so the preferred level is not fully satisfied. It satisfies both expressly stated fallback thresholds. The revision preserves the bankruptcy provision and introduces no contradiction, but it is not minimal because it adds an unrequested one-year post-term coverage obligation and extends the cyber trigger to Corio data in addition to Customer Data.
